summary: Example life-event categories that can become active when natal promise, progression, return chart emphasis, and transit triggers repeat the same theme.
body: Use these examples to translate timing testimony into plain-life language. They are not standalone predictions. The app should surface them only when multiple indicators repeat the same house topic, planet pair, or activated ruler.
definition: A life-event trigger is a repeated astrological testimony pattern that points toward a lived topic becoming active, such as relationship change, home movement, career decision, legal process, health caution, or financial restructuring.
appUsage: Never present a listed event as guaranteed from one transit.
Require at least three reinforcing indicators before raising an event category to high confidence.
Show the user the plain category first, then the supporting signals if they want detail.
Use sensitive language for health, safety, pregnancy, custody, legal, and relationship topics.
When serious risk is implied, recommend practical care, professional support, or real-world caution instead of dramatic prediction.
note: Distilled from approved predictive astrology reference material. Source files were not copied into the repository.

confidenceRule.low: One indicator describes a theme, not an event.
confidenceRule.medium: Two indicators repeating the same topic show an active pattern worth watching.
confidenceRule.high: Three or more indicators repeating the same topic can be presented as a likely life area of focus, still without promising a specific outcome.

relationshipCommitmentOrSeparation.plainMeaning: Partnership status, commitment talks, marriage, divorce, separation, or defining the relationship.
commonSignals: 7th house, 7th ruler, Venus, Moon, Saturn, or relationship angles activated
Return chart emphasis on 7th house or angular Venus/Saturn
Progressed Moon, Venus, Sun, or 7th ruler making close contacts
Transits repeating the same Venus/Saturn/Moon/7th-house theme
relationshipCommitmentOrSeparation.userLanguage: The relationship question is not background noise right now. The chart repeats partnership, commitment, definition, and consequence.

childrenPregnancyAndCustody.plainMeaning: Children, pregnancy news, custody decisions, childcare obligations, or major developments involving a child.
commonSignals: 5th house, 5th ruler, Moon, Venus, Jupiter, or nodal contacts activated
Solar and Lunar Return charts repeating 5th-house or family themes
Legal houses joining 5th-house testimony for custody or court decisions
Moon timing a return-chart angle or activated 5th-house point
childrenPregnancyAndCustody.userLanguage: Children, care, family responsibility, or the future of a child may be part of the active storyline.

homeMovePropertyAndFamily.plainMeaning: Moving, buying or selling property, changes in household structure, family developments, or domestic upheaval.
commonSignals: 4th house, 4th ruler, Moon, Mars, Saturn, or IC activated
Solar Return or Lunar Return emphasis on 3rd, 4th, or 9th houses
Moon-Mars patterns linked to domestic uprooting or relocation
Transit trigger to return-chart IC, Moon, Mars, or 4th ruler
homeMovePropertyAndFamily.userLanguage: Home is not just scenery here. The chart repeats movement, roots, property, family, or the structure of private life.

careerJobAndPublicRole.plainMeaning: Career move, promotion, job change, public recognition, responsibility shift, or authority encounter.
commonSignals: 10th house, 10th ruler, MC, Sun, Saturn, Jupiter, or chart ruler activated
Return chart Sun or return planet angular
Progressed contacts to the MC, 10th ruler, Sun, Saturn, or Jupiter
Transits crossing return-chart angles or repeating career-house testimony
careerJobAndPublicRole.userLanguage: The public-life question is active: work, visibility, authority, reputation, or the next role you are being asked to occupy.

moneyDebtAndSharedResources.plainMeaning: Income changes, financial strain or consolidation, debt, shared money, inheritance, taxes, or partner resources.
commonSignals: 2nd or 8th house, their rulers, Venus, Jupiter, Saturn, Pluto, or Mars activated
Return chart emphasis on financial houses
Saturn in a money house showing consolidation, responsibility, or temporary drain
Jupiter or Venus showing opportunity only when supported by the rest of the chart
moneyDebtAndSharedResources.userLanguage: Money is asking for structure. This can describe gain, expense, debt management, shared resources, or a clearer relationship with value.

legalCourtAndFormalDecision.plainMeaning: Court dates, legal rulings, contracts, formal agreements, immigration, publishing, higher education, or institutional decisions.
commonSignals: 9th house, 7th house, 3rd house, Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, or relevant house rulers activated
Solar and Lunar Returns repeating 7th/9th/3rd-house themes
Mercury, Jupiter, or Saturn angular or tied to return-chart angles
Moon timing an activated return angle on the decision date
legalCourtAndFormalDecision.userLanguage: A formal decision, agreement, document, legal matter, or institutional process may be part of the active field.

vehicleTravelAndLogistics.plainMeaning: Vehicle purchase or repair, travel, paperwork, commuting changes, shipping, technology, or scheduling problems.
commonSignals: Mercury return or Mercury-heavy return chart
3rd or 9th house, Mercury, Mars, Uranus, or return-chart angles activated
Mercury retrograde or Mercury station repeating a transit/progression theme
Mars adding urgency, mechanical stress, or accident-prone haste
vehicleTravelAndLogistics.userLanguage: Logistics need attention: transport, documents, messages, devices, schedules, and the choices that keep daily life moving.

newEnterpriseAndActionRisk.plainMeaning: Launching a business, starting a project, taking a risk, beginning training, or acting on a plan.
commonSignals: Mars return or Mars strongly angular in a return chart
Mars, Sun, Jupiter, 1st house, 10th house, or 2nd house activated
Progressed Mars or Sun tied to natal or return-chart angles
Transiting Mars crossing a return angle or triggering the project planet
newEnterpriseAndActionRisk.userLanguage: The chart supports movement, but it also asks for aim. Start the thing with a plan so heat becomes momentum instead of mess.

healthCautionAndBodyStress.plainMeaning: Health maintenance, fatigue, inflammation, recovery needs, medical appointments, accidents, or body stress.
commonSignals: 6th house, 12th house, Ascendant, Sun, Moon, Mars, Saturn, Neptune, or chart ruler under repeated stress
Mars-Moon contacts repeating across progressions, returns, or transits
Return charts emphasizing 6th/12th houses or malefic angularity
Transiting Mars or Saturn triggering a natal or progressed health-sensitive pattern
healthCautionAndBodyStress.userLanguage: The body is part of the message. Slow down, get support, handle the practical care, and do not treat stress signals as background noise.

lossClosureAndMajorTransition.plainMeaning: A chapter closing, role ending, grief process, retirement, withdrawal, or major transition that changes the life structure.
commonSignals: 12th house, 8th house, 4th house, Saturn, Pluto, Neptune, progressed lunation endings, or return-chart closure signatures activated
Balsamic or New phase in progressed lunation cycle
Saturn Return or progressed phase boundary overlapping a transit trigger
Repeated testimony involving endings, retreat, release, or private restructuring
lossClosureAndMajorTransition.userLanguage: Something may be completing. That does not make the next step visible yet. Treat closure as real work, not as failure.

publicPeakAndVisibility.plainMeaning: Public culmination, recognition, exposure, announcement, launch, reputation moment, or visible result.
commonSignals: MC, 10th house, Sun, Full phase, Jupiter, Saturn, or return planet angular
Progressed Full Moon or solar return emphasis on the 10th
Lunar Return matching Solar Return themes for the event month
Transiting Moon, Sun, or return planet crossing return-chart angles
publicPeakAndVisibility.userLanguage: The work is visible now. This can feel like achievement, exposure, pressure, or a result that cannot stay private.

timingTools.solarReturn: Describes the major yearly field. Look for angular planets, repeated natal themes, and the houses of the return Sun, Moon, and Ascendant.
timingTools.lunarReturn: Times the month when yearly themes peak. A Lunar Return that closely repeats the Solar Return often marks the most eventful four-week period.
timingTools.planetaryReturn: Maps a planet-specific cycle. Track the return planet through the return chart for peaks in that planet's topics.
timingTools.progressedChart: Shows the life chapter currently developing. Use transits to time when the progressed theme becomes active.
timingTools.transitingMoon: Useful for short timing when it crosses return-chart angles or triggers an already active configuration.

prohibitions: Do not predict a specific event from one indicator.
Do not use health or safety examples to diagnose, frighten, or replace professional support.
Do not present relationship, pregnancy, custody, legal, or financial outcomes as guaranteed.
Do not expose technical confidence scoring as a verdict; translate it as theme strength.
weighting: High confidence requires at least three repeating indicators.
Angular contacts in return charts are stronger than cadent background contacts.
A Lunar Return repeating the Solar Return can time the peak month of a yearly theme.
Return planet transits through its own return chart can time planet-specific events.
The transiting Moon can time the day only when a larger pattern is already active.
